about: Curated alias dictionary for the entity extractor. Aliases are matched case-sensitively as whole words against headlines. people_use marks products and services ordinary people use; it gates which vulnerabilities reach the feed. logo is the key the web app uses to find the logo (or draw a lettermark). not_organizations lists reporters, agencies and regions, and countries lists every country by its common names: neither is ever the affected organization (a national body with a name of its own, such as FinCEN or the US Treasury, still is).
